status: FROZEN AFTER REPOSITORY-EVIDENCE REVIEW AND BEFORE ANY NEW SOURCE, NETWORK, OR GPU ACCESS
objective: Decide whether a new all-128-expert same-layer template/prototype experiment is justified before opening any additional Qwen payload.

target.promotion_rule: promote only if a leakage-safe optimistic bound supplies at least the nested remaining requirement; otherwise stop before new payload or GPU access

nonduplication_review.prior_mean_and_pca: research/neural_flow_oracle/shared_expert_basis_oracle.json already tests leave-one-expert-out mean templates and exact learned PCA spans on 16 authenticated layer-15 Up/Down experts
nonduplication_review.prior_alignment: agent_rd_structure_diag_cross_expert_result.json already tests identity, reference-Hungarian, and two-pass barycenter-Hungarian neuron alignment with disjoint fit/evaluation columns on the same authenticated cohort
nonduplication_review.new_hypothesis_considered: a held-out expert chooses one train-only clustered prototype after a function-preserving shared permutation of gate/up rows and down columns
nonduplication_review.reason_it_is_distinct: prototype choice is nonlinear in expert identity and reads only one prototype, unlike a dense expert-axis KLT or a multi-basis PCA decoder

unaligned_dominance_gate.cohort: 16 authenticated layer-15 experts {0,8,...,120}; Up and transposed Down
unaligned_dominance_gate.heldout_rule: each learned object excludes the evaluated expert
unaligned_dominance_gate.candidate_family: each direct mean, medoid, cluster mean, or scalar-gained prototype is a vector in the span of the 15 training experts
unaligned_dominance_gate.optimistic_bound: orthogonal projection onto the complete exact rank-15 training span has no larger SSE than choosing any one vector in that span
unaligned_dominance_gate.physical_favor: the bound ignores prototype quantization error, cluster mappings, gains, and read costs

aligned_plausibility_gate.bounded_family: the already-tested identity, fixed-reference Hungarian, and two-pass barycenter Hungarian column-split alignments
aligned_plausibility_gate.leakage_safe_row: alignment fit on canonical columns j mod 4 in {0,1}; opportunity scored on disjoint columns j mod 4 in {2,3}
aligned_plausibility_gate.optimistic_stress_row: also inspect the explicitly outcome-leaky full-column role-specific KLT opportunity; failure by a wide margin stops rather than promoting a new 128-expert fetch
aligned_plausibility_gate.moment_matched_control: same-total-rate reverse water filling on the fitted covariance diagonal, exactly as recorded in the prior result
aligned_plausibility_gate.not_a_converse_for: arbitrary combinatorial neuron permutations, nonlinear function-space matching, or an untested gate-projection-only family

hypothetical_all_128_protocol_if_promote.expert_crossfit: even expert IDs train odd IDs and odd IDs train even IDs
hypothetical_all_128_protocol_if_promote.alignment_crossfit: fit held-out permutations only on columns j mod 4 in {0,1}; score j mod 4 in {2,3}
hypothetical_all_128_protocol_if_promote.fitting: deterministic train-only cluster means; held-out assignment may use its fit columns and must store a literal cluster ID
hypothetical_all_128_protocol_if_promote.control: independently fit a role-wise moment-matched iid Gaussian cohort with identical dimensions, folds, fitting, assignment, and stopping
hypothetical_all_128_protocol_if_promote.physical_accounting: charge both crossfit prototype banks, enumerative neuron permutations, cluster IDs, gains, headers, and residual streams over all 128 experts
hypothetical_all_128_protocol_if_promote.cold_read_rule: one residual plus one selected prototype and local mapping must remain below 2x attributed expert bytes

strict_access_contract.permitted_inputs: only the three exact source-free files bound above
forbidden: the six pinned production-panel BF16 expert triplets
any holdout, confirmation, quarantine, or sealed payload directory
any model shard or HTTP byte range

claim_boundary: This gate can kill unaligned train-only linear-combination prototypes/clusters and the named bounded column-alignment family. It is not a theorem about arbitrary combinatorial neuron permutation, nonlinear functional alignment, or gate_proj considered alone.
